outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of an H&E micrograph and spatial gene-expression maps (Tmprss11b, Krt13, Krt6a) overlaid on tissue with a continuous color scale (heatmap-type visualization). Heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel B contains only RNAscope/H&E micrographs, no quantitative plot showing averaged data.
Panel C is a scatter/dot plot showing every individual patient's TMPRSS11B expression value (LUAD n=512, LUSC n=500) with median and 95% CI overlaid, so individual data points are already displayed.
Panel D is a bar chart (mean ± SD) with individual data points (dots for each of the n=3 replicates) overlaid on each bar, satisfying the requirement.
